jobs.employer_name: ISR International School on the Rhine GmbH
jobs.description:
Job Overview

ISR is accredited by the German authorities as an ‘Anerkannte Internationale Ergänzungsschule’ (International Supplementary School) and by the US accrediting agency Cognia (formerly known as AdvancED). ISR is an IB World School authorized to offer the IB Diploma Programme, and also offers Cambridge Assessment International Education (CAIE) IGCSE courses. The school is a certified member of the Council of International Schools (CIS).

We wish to hire a dedicated and qualified full-time Admissions Employee (m/f/d) to join our dynamic educational institution from Autumn, 2026.

The successful candidate should be outgoing, confident in communicating with a wide range of people and able to build positive relationships quickly. Strong interpersonal skills, a collaborative mindset and a flexible approach to work are essential. A general understanding of different school systems and educational pathways would be an advantage.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

- Proactively contact interested families, provide relevant information and identify their individual needs.
- Manage and respond to all incoming enquiries from prospective families in a timely and professional manner.
- Maintain accurate records in the admissions database and ensure consistent follow-up throughout the enquiry process.
- Conduct school tours during regular school operations and provide personalised guidance on ISR’s educational programs and school community.
- Support prospective families throughout the entire application and enrolment process.
- Represent ISR and present its educational concept at internal and external events.
- Attend and actively support the planning, coordination, and delivery of information sessions, open days, and Saturday Info Days.
- Build positive and trusting relationships with prospective families while ensuring a welcoming and professional experience at every stage

Qualifications

- Completed vocational training or a university degree.
- Previous experience in customer service, client advisory or sales.
- Excellent written and spoken English and German; additional language skills would be an advantage.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- A professional, service-oriented and approachable manner.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Flexibility, reliability and strong organisational skills.
- Strong IT skills, particularly in Microsoft Office applications.
- Experience with Veracross is an advantage

Job Benefits

We are looking for someone who can make an immediate impact in a fast-paced, dynamic, and rewarding working environment. In return, we offer a range of opportunities for professional growth and career development.

If you are enthusiastic, highly motivated, enjoy a challenge, and believe you can contribute to the continued growth and development of our new ISR Elementary School Düsseldorf, we would be delighted to hear from you.

WE ARE HIRING

Attorney-at-Law (m/f/d)
Commercial Law (North Macedonian Law) – Full-time or Part-time (min. 30h/week)
Location: initially Dresden, Germany / prospectively North Macedonia

WHO WE ARE

At NAUTARIS. legal | tax, we are not a traditional law firm with dusty files and dictation. We are an international, digitally oriented team of over 60 lawyers, tax experts, and accountants across Germany, the Czech Republic, and Poland, delivering outstanding work. We provide holistic, practical, and forward-looking advice to businesses—both legally and tax-wise.

A particular focus of our work lies in international and cross-border matters. Looking ahead, we plan to establish our own office in North Macedonia at a central location (e.g., Skopje, Bitola, Ohrid, or similar). We see significant economic and legal potential there and aim to develop this location deliberately and responsibly, closely connected to our existing offices.

WHAT WE OFFER

- A strategically exciting position with an international perspective
- Thorough onboarding and close support during the initial phase
- An interdisciplinary and appreciative working environment
- Clear structures, short decision-making processes, and genuine trust
- The opportunity to actively help build and shape a new office location
- Long-term collaboration with development prospects
- Permanent full-time or part-time employment (min. 30h/week)
- Predictable and flexible working hours with electronic time tracking
- A modern, well-equipped workplace
- A strong team culture: shared breakfasts, team events, and celebrations that strengthen cohesion
- Further training opportunities through seminars, training sessions, and individual programs, even during the probation period
- Free beverages, massages, parking options, and attractive additional benefits such as a monthly tax-free non-cash benefit of €50

WHAT YOU BRING

- You are a fully qualified lawyer (advokat) with solid knowledge of North Macedonian law, with a focus on commercial law
- You are a well-rounded commercial lawyer, not narrowly specialized
- Ideally, you have 2–3 years of professional experience (not mandatory)
- Business-fluent German or English skills (one of the two is required), as well as openness to using translation tools in daily work
- A high willingness to travel between Germany and North Macedonia

What matters most is that you are open to new legal and economic topics and are able to familiarize yourself with international and cross-border legal matters, particularly EU law, private international law, and relevant treaties. In addition, you bring economic and organizational understanding, as well as enthusiasm for building structures and contributing entrepreneurially.

You work in a highly independent and structured manner and demonstrate integrity, discretion, and loyalty toward the firm and our clients. You communicate effectively, even across distances.

You think long-term and entrepreneurially and are able to find creative solutions to complex economic and organizational challenges.

YOUR PERSPECTIVE

- Your place of work will initially be in Dresden, Germany, for 1–2 years.
- During this time, you will gain a comprehensive understanding of our working methods, client structure, firm culture, and interdisciplinary collaboration with our tax advisory team.
- At the same time, you will be regularly involved in project-based work in North Macedonia.
- The experience and structures gained in Germany will be gradually and transformatively transferred to North Macedonia and will play a key role in establishing and supporting a new office there.
- The exact location will be determined jointly and is intentionally kept open.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Providing legal advice to companies in a business-oriented environment
- Advising under North Macedonian law in the field of commercial law in its full scope, in particular: - Corporate law (including company formations, restructurings, and dissolutions)
- Drafting and negotiating contracts
- Supporting location decisions and investment projects
- Employment law matters
- Interfaces with tax law in close cooperation with our tax advisors
- Advising on funding opportunities and business-related regulatory frameworks
- Supporting and actively shaping business processes
- Building, maintaining, and developing client relationships
- In the long term: co-establishing and independently managing a law firm office in North Macedonia in close coordination with the Dresden office
- Regular professional and organizational exchange with the German team

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU

Are you interested in joining us on this journey of building a new office in North Macedonia and looking for a long-term position explicitly designed as an employment relationship? Then let’s talk.

About us Quality & Innovations from IronMaxx® Nutrition
Premium sports nutrition - Designed in Germany!
Producing the best sports nutrition worldwide is the goal of IronMaxx®.

The production of highly efficient sports nutrition of the best quality and the constant further development of our products led to the award of the State Prize for Excellent Food Quality by the State of North Rhine-Westphalia. However, this is no reason for us to rest on our laurels - we are constantly working with the greatest passion to offer you supplements that inspire, work and taste great! The integration of the latest study results and the evaluation of practical field research in cooperation with professional sports clubs and our customers have led to permanent innovation in the development of new sports and fitness nutrition at IronMaxx® Nutrition since the company was founded in 2004.

In addition to the basics of sports nutrition in the areas of strength/endurance, muscle building and diet , this includes effective nutritional supplements for health and prevention , intelligent new combinations of active ingredients and improved dosage forms, such as our Tricaps® .

In the area of protein products, for example, IronMaxx® has set a milestone in the evolution of the latest sports nutrition products with the development of water-based protein powders in over 31 flavors. Designed in Germany - as a German sports nutrition manufacturer, IronMaxx® is also committed to outstanding quality and seamless quality control.

High performance - the goal is the goal.

Well-known professional clubs, such as the eight-time German ice hockey champions, the "Kölner Haie", or the traditional handball club VfL Gummersbach with its unique success story, have relied for years on the efficient sports nutrition from IronMaxx® and on our expertise in the use and mode of action of nutritional supplements.

While in many areas of life the "path is often proclaimed as the goal", our customers usually have a very clear idea of their "dream body" and its desired performance. This passion to achieve their personal goa l is something we share with all our partners and customers - be it an athletic body, achieving new personal bests, reducing body weight or achieving sporting team success.

IronMaxx® products have therefore become an integral part of the product range of many European fitness studios, wholesalers, pharmacies and body stores in recent years due to their high quality.

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.

Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.

Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.

Keys to Success

You combine a strong scientific or technical background with commercial drive and a genuine passion for understanding and solving customer challenges.
